+- [ ] A `/nosuchcmd` prompt yields an error mentioning the nearest name and no model turn (scripted backend never invoked)
+- [ ] A provider command colliding with a builtin name loses; the builtin still dispatches

+    public func commands(workingDirectory: URL) async -> [SlashCommand]

+
+Attachments (§14.3): extra content blocks accompany prompt-style commands into the expanded turn. For an `.action` command, refuse the invocation with a reason.
